officialLyrics.text: Manual en-GB captions of the 2022 live video, original language plus English. Verbatim sung text and the 63 cue times are in content/songs/one/canon.md. The Turkish caption track has the same cue boundaries and a translation, not the Arabic letters.

pieces.title: Daz ouge, da inne ich got sihe (sung orthography)
pieces.author: Meister Eckhart
pieces.text:
Daz ouge, da inne ich got sihe
daz ist daz selbe ouge, da inne mich got sihet
min ouge und gotes ouge daz ist ein ouge
pieces.notes: Re-read 2026-10-17 from the artist article (signed SY, three italic lines, no circumflexes, sihet, und) and from the live en-GB captions. The 2020 captions use the same spelling. Two cues write 'daz istein' (45.000–54.440 and 153.018–161.146); neighbouring cues and the English 'are one eye' read it as two words. Not heard. Pfeiffer 1857, Predigt XCVI, p. 312, has siht and unde with circumflexes; that edition spelling is not what the captions print. A clean Quint page was not opened, so the acute on ein is not confirmed.

pieces.title: Predigt XCVI Qui audit me, Pfeiffer 1857, p. 312
pieces.author: Meister Eckhart
pieces.text: daz dâ gesehen wirt mit dem ougen, dâ inne ich got sihe, daz ist daz selbe ouge, dâ inne mich got siht: mîn ouge unde gotes ouge daz ist ein ouge und ein gesiht und ein bekennen und ein minnen.
pieces.notes: Page images re-read 2026-10-17. n324 is printed p. 309 and carries the heading XCVI. Qui audit me, non confundetur (Eccles. XXIV, 30). n327 is printed p. 312; the eye sentence is in the paragraph that ends the sermon, before heading XCVII. Earlier citation of n328 was the next page. The sung finale uses these last nouns without circumflexes and with und: daz ist ein ouge / und ein gesiht / und ein bekennen / und ein minnen, fourteen short cues from 729.384 to 764.339, not one sentence in the opening. eckhart.de was not fetched this pass, so a Quint page number is not repeated here.

pieces.title: Lings, Sufi Poems, no. 58
pieces.author: Abu al-Hasan al-Shushtari (attribution via Shaykh al-Alawi; Lings says it is not in the diwan)
pieces.text:
خرجت في حين بعد الفنا
ومن هنا بقيت بلا أنا
ومن أنا يا أنا إلا أنا
pieces.notes: Arabic consonants read from the scan of printed p. 89 (leaf n99). English of no. 58 is on printed p. 88: After extinction I came out, and I / Eternal now am, though not as I. / And who am I, O I, but I. Note 97 (notes p. 100 in the djvu text) says the poem is not in Shushtari's diwan and that Shaykh al-Alawi quoted it and attributed it to him, citing A Sufi Saint of the Twentieth Century, p. 127. That page was not opened, so this is one literary witness. Printed vowel signs were not copied mark by mark. Sung caption text, same on the 2020 and 2022 videos: خَرَجْتُ في حِين بَعْدَ الفَنَا / وَمِنْ هُنَا بَقِيتُ بِلاَ أنَا / وَمنْ أنَا يا أنَا إلاَّ أنَا, plus the fragments يا أنَا إلاَّ أنَا and إلاَّ أنَا. The muwashshah كم درت في ذاتي (aldiwan poem69206) has ظفرت بي حقا / أبقى and is not in these captions.

pieces.title: سقيت كأس الهوى قديما
pieces.author: Abu al-Hasan al-Shushtari
pieces.text:
سقيت كأس الهوى قديما
من غير أرضي ولا سمائي
أصبحت به فريد عصري
بين الورى حاملا لوائي
لي مذهب ، مذهب عجيب
في الحبّ قد فاق يا هنائي
يا من همو للجميل أهل
إن لم يمنّوا فيا شقائي
حاشكمو يا أهيل نجد
أن تقطعوا منكمو رجائي
pieces.notes: Unvocalized text re-read from the Adluni / Abu al-Fuyud diwan, p. 28. aldiwan poem69371 has the same words vocalized, including printed oddities. ar.wikisource copies that vocalized text and is tagged as an unknown-source page, so it is not a second witness. Sung form on both official caption tracks differs and is kept as sung: فيه not به, بالحسن not في الحب, تمنوا not يمنوا, أرض/سماء without ya, حاشاكم/منكم/هم without waw, and سُقَيْتُ with fatha on qaf. No second manuscript of those sung readings was found. The fatha on qaf was not heard.

openQuestions: Nine vocal stretches have energy on the voice map and no caption: 246.4–250, 326.6–332.2, 355.0–367.1, 474–476.2, 622–632, 671–674, 714–721, 764.3–786, 793–828. Only listening or lyric frames can say whether they are words, melisma or a false voice detection.
Who sings each Arabic line is not in the captions.

The finale is captioned as Cappella-style German, but the 2022 blurb only says the piece opens with the choir. Amen at 740 s is a Whisper token sitting on the caption und ein gesiht; it was not heard.
Two cues print daz istein. Not heard.
Caption سُقَيْتُ has fatha on qaf. Not heard; it may be a subtitle vowel.
A single caption track does not show whether German and Arabic overlap.
Caption time versus the encrypted file was not aligned. Durations are both about 828 s.
Lings p. 89 vowel signs were not copied mark by mark. Al-Alawi, A Sufi Saint of the Twentieth Century, p. 127, was not opened. A clean Quint text, including the acute on ein, was not read.

The 2022 per-person roster was not verified. play.samaanetwork.net was not re-opened, and yt-dlp on the 2022 video returned HTTP 429, so a credits block in the video description was not re-read. Do not treat the previous Samaa name list as confirmed. Guo Gan, Jon Lawton and the bağlama remain unverified for this file.
German-translator credit: Holland Festival 2020 page says Katherine O'Brien. Maurice O'C. Walshe was not re-checked in the 2020 video description.
